description: Create a Live Station VOD-to-Live channel (vodchannelcreate). CDN is Global Edge — give profileId, and either createCdn=true with regionType or createCdn=false with cdnDomain + cdnInstanceNo. Use dryRun=true to preview.

cdnDomain.description: Existing CDN domain (required when createCdn=false in the Public zone; see ncloud_edge_list_edges)

cdnInstanceNo.description: Existing CDN instance number (required when createCdn=false)

channelName.description: Channel name (3-20 chars: Korean, letters, digits, '_')

createCdn.description: true to create a new CDN, false to use an existing one

drmContentId.description: Multi DRM content ID (3-100 chars: letters, digits, '-', '_'; required when drmEnabledYn=true)

drmEnabledYn.description: Enable Multi DRM (Public zone; required there — defaults to false)

drmSiteId.description: Multi DRM site ID (required when drmEnabledYn=true; see ncloud_drm_list_sites)

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without creating

profileId.description: Global Edge profile ID (required; see ncloud_edge_list_profiles)

qualitySetId.description: Quality set ID (see ncloud_livestation_list_quality_settings; pick a Low Latency set for LL_HLS)

regionType.description: Global Edge service region (required when createCdn=true in the Public zone)

name: ncloud_livestation_create_vod_channel
